widgets_values:
MPI-1041 Character Sheet Editor - the Qwen-Image 2.1 edit graph (generated by build_edit_graph_qwen.py, pruned from qwen_image_2_1.json's edit path).

The app fills: Input_Image (the finished 3-panel sheet), Input_Positive (the WHOLE prompt - the Flow's builder writes it, nothing is baked here), Input_Seed.

Size: TextEncodeQwenImage21 resolution is baked 0 = the sheet at its own size, each side rounded to a multiple of 32, and the canvas follows picture 1, so the edit is not resized at all on a 32-multiple sheet. The result is stretched back to the INPUT size (a no-op at 1792x1120).

Alpha is dropped: the 2.1 VAE decodes RGBA. Research licence: the pictures are non-commercial.

Replace the person with a plain white mannequin seen in a three-quarter view, and keep the hairstyle exactly as it is: the same length, shape and colour. No jewellery and no clothes, on a plain grey background.
